New: swipe cleanup! A second tab where you go through old photos and videos one month at a time. Swipe right to keep, left to say bye.

- oldest months first, each with its size and how far you got
- swipes are remembered, so a half-done month picks up where you left off
- undo button, plus a bye pile to look over before anything is deleted
- a running count of how much space you've freed
- deletes go to the phone's trash by default, or straight away if you flip the switch in settings

Needs Android 11 or newer. Download octo-potato.apk below and open it on your phone.
